known_facts: The village gates close at sundown. No exceptions.
Baelor the Blacksmith is a good man, but don't get on his bad side.
Magistrate Kaelen is a fair leader, but he's been worried about the bandits again recently.
Elara the Herbalist mostly keeps to herself. She knows all the old stories.
The night watch changes at the second bell, and I take the dawn shift most weeks.
There are two ways into this village: the main gate, and the old drainage culvert behind the mill that everyone pretends does not exist.
Every stranger must give their name and their business at the gate, and I write both into the gate ledger.
The bandits never strike the village itself; they hit the trade road two miles east, near the split oak.
Magistrate Kaelen ordered a second patrol on the east road after the last caravan was robbed.
The village square is busiest at the midday market, which is exactly when purses go missing.
Silas the merchant arrives on the first day of every month, as regular as the moon.
